targets.descriptor: The all-over motif is a double-F monogram repeat set in offset horizontal rows that run continuously across body and sleeves with no placement break at the shoulder or side seams, and the rows read slightly larger across the chest than at the lower body. Each motif is rendered in a mottled, bleached, denim-washed manner — pale chalky fill inside dark irregular outlines, with brush-like breakup so no two repeats look identical — giving the cloth a faded indigo-print appearance rather than a clean flat print. The body is cut squarely: the side line falls straight from the underarm to a plain unshaped hem with no taper, and the short sleeve hangs as a straight tube ending mid-upper arm with a plain turned edge.
